title: FMP Linux Characterization Corpus
description: Track corpus for regression, determinism and extraction baselines. Synthetic tracks are distributable; local tracks reference user-provided content and require FMP.COM.

synthetic.description: Synthetic or freely-distributable test fixtures. Currently limited to COM programs used by Nise98 unit tests. Future OVI files may be added if license-compatible source material is available.

tracks.name: exit-com
tracks.description: COM program that exits immediately. 2 bytes.

tracks.name: halt-com
tracks.description: COM program that halts (HLT instruction). 1 byte.

tracks.name: test-com
tracks.description: COM program that writes values to memory. 4 bytes.

local.description: User-provided tracks. Configured via local/local-config.json (gitignored). These are used for integration-level rendering tests and golden artifact generation.
